statement_scope: Given finitely triangulated PL3M with sphere and proper-disk ball bounds and positive-genus boundary, every integral relative H2 class admits an oriented incompressible and boundary-incompressible representative; one class spans all boundary components. No smooth/PL conversion or superincompressibility claimed.
essential_local_proof_operations: Explicit simplicial integral 1-cocycle gives a circle map with integer vertex values; half-integer levels give genuine locally flat collared PL surfaces.
Dual-cell/intersection count verifies the integral relative class.

Lexicographic minimum of total negative Euler characteristic, total genus and number of annuli excludes all compressions and boundary compressions; sphere/disk components removed using actual stated ball bounds.
Cap-boundary identity and exact pair sequence prove the boundary image is its own symplectic annihilator; no boundary summand projection can vanish.
A finite polynomial combination avoids every boundary projection kernel and gives one integral class meeting all boundaries.
